heroes.name: D.Mon
heroes.summary: Extensive nerfs to lifesteal and barrier deployment significantly reduce her frontline durability and utility.

changes.note: Lifesteal reduced from 150% to 125%.
Recovery increased from 0.2 to 0.3 seconds.
Now has a 0.25 second minimum deploy duration.
Impact damage reduced from 15 to 0.

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.summary: Substantial health increases and a shorter Carnage cooldown make her an even more formidable presence in brawls.

changes.note: Base health increased from 375 to 425.
Base health increased from 450 to 500. (6v6)
Added a new UI element that tracks allies within range and allies currently affected by Commanding Shout.
Cooldown reduced from 9 to 7 seconds.

heroes.name: Mauga
heroes.summary: Improvements to armor and burn damage over time enhance his sustain and lethality during prolonged fights.

changes.note: Base armor increased from 125 to 150.
Burning damage over time increased from 15 to 20.

heroes.name: Ramattra
heroes.summary: A larger ammo pool for Void Accelerator improves his poke phase and consistency in Omnic form.

changes.note: Ammo increased from 100 to 125.

heroes.name: Winston
heroes.summary: Reductions to passive healing and Tesla Field damage decrease his dive survivability and area-of-effect pressure.

changes.note: Healing per second reduced from 35 to 30.
Tesla Field damage reduced to 30 every 1s (Down from 40).

heroes.name: Anran
heroes.summary: Increased primary fire damage and faster ultimate casting are offset by the removal of Inferno Rush knockback and multi-hit potential.

changes.note: Damage increased from 22 to 24.
Knockback removed.
Can no longer hit the same target multiple times per use.
Cast time reduced from 1.2 to 1 second.

heroes.name: Echo
heroes.summary: The addition of ammo refills on ability use provides better combat flow and higher uptime during critical moments.

changes.note: Now additionally refills ammo on use.

heroes.name: Emre
heroes.summary: A faster detonation time for Cyber Frag makes his burst damage more reliable and harder for enemies to avoid.

changes.note: Added Rotation reticle setting for default reticle.
Removed Thickness reticle setting for default reticle.
Fixed visual inconsistency regarding default reticle crosshairs not using Outline Thickness and Outline Shift values.
Updated default reticle preview in Options to more closely reflect in-game reticle.
Detonation time reduced from 0.6 to 0.5 seconds.

heroes.name: Genji
heroes.summary: Trading Deflect duration for higher Swift Strike damage scaling shifts his focus toward high-risk, high-reward assassination.

changes.note: Duration reduced from 2 to 1.5 seconds.
Swift Strike Damage per stack increased to 15% (Up from 10%).

heroes.name: Hanzo
heroes.summary: Minor interaction fix concerning hacked health packs with no impact on his primary combat kit.

changes.note: No longer overrides Sombra's hacked health packs.

heroes.name: Reaper
heroes.summary: A flat increase to base health significantly improves his survivability in close-quarters engagements.

changes.note: Base health increased from 275 to 300.

heroes.name: Shion
heroes.summary: Reduced spread and faster volley times greatly enhance her accuracy and burst potential at mid-range.

changes.note: Starting spread reduced from 8.5 to 5.7 degrees.
Cast time/move time per volley reduced from 0.6 to 0.5 seconds.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.summary: Widespread nerfs to mobility, knockback, and sustain significantly lower her overall impact and survivability.

changes.note: Overhead leap speed reduced from 11 to 9.5.
Initial swing delay increased from 0.15 to 0.2 seconds.
Raging Storm perk horizontal knockback reduced from 8 to 4.
Lifesteal reduced to 3% (Down from 4%).
Eliminations per increased stack of Onslaught increased to 3 (Up from 2).

heroes.name: Ana
heroes.summary: A significant reduction in Biotic Grenade's explosion damage lowers her self-defense and offensive burst capability.

changes.note: Explosion damage reduced from 90 to 60.

heroes.name: Baptiste
heroes.summary: The addition of a tracking UI for Regenerative Burst provides better clarity for team management without changing power levels.

changes.note: Added a new UI element that tracks allies within range and allies currently affected by Regenerative Burst.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.summary: Improvements to Inspire uptime and instant healing values bolster her throughput as a defensive support anchor.

changes.note: Internal cooldown reduced from 1.25 to 1 second.
Instant healing increased from 12 to 15.

heroes.name: Doctrine
heroes.summary: Severe nerfs to primary fire speed, infused values, and ability cooldowns drastically reduce his efficiency in all roles.

changes.note: Primary Fire recovery time increased from 0.6 to 0.65
Infused Damage reduced from 90 to 80.
Infused Healing reduced from 120 to 110.
Cooldown increased from 8 to 10 seconds.
Cooldown increased from 8 to 9 seconds.

heroes.name: Illari
heroes.summary: Faster rifle charging and increased Pylon healing improve her ability to juggle damage and support simultaneously.

changes.note: Time to maximum charge reduced from 0.65 to 0.575.
Heal per projectile increased from 40 to 50.

heroes.name: Jetpack Cat
heroes.summary: While more agile in flight, the reductions to base health and fuel regeneration make the hero much more vulnerable and less persistent.

changes.note: Base health reduced from 225 to 200.
Acceleration increased from 25 to 28 meters per second.
Fuel regeneration rate reduced from 25% to 20% per second.

heroes.name: Sombra
heroes.summary: Reductions to ability duration and weaken strength outweigh the benefit of improved health pack control via EMP.

changes.note: Duration reduced from 12 to 10 seconds.
Weaken effect reduced from 50% to 40%.
Now overrides enemy hack effects on health packs.

heroes.name: Cassidy
heroes.summary: Reduced damage penalties and higher base damage output significantly increase his lethality and dueling power.

changes.note: Damage increased to 50% reduced damage (Up from 60% reduced).
Damage increased to 60 (Up from 50).

heroes.name: Sojourn
heroes.summary: A major reduction in damage penalties boosts her overall damage floor and makes her primary fire more threatening.

changes.note: Damage increased to 10% reduced damage (Up from 25% reduced).
